purpose: Keep the massive world build inside the 8GB RAM / ~2GB VRAM target by making region working sets explicit and preventing global hard-reference residency.
hard_rules: Heavy region assets are referenced with TSoftObjectPtr/TSoftClassPtr.
Heavy runtime acquisition uses FStreamableManager asynchronous loading.
Synchronous heavy LoadObject paths are forbidden.
Global systems may know asset IDs/soft paths but must not hard-reference every region kit.
Only the current route/region working set plus bounded transition overlap may remain resident.
Leaving a region releases no-longer-needed handles after the destination world-state commit is stable.
Shared family reuse reduces duplicate assets but does not make the entire shared family permanently resident.

residency_tiers.rule: May remain resident if measured cost is negligible and required across routes.
Primary runtime working set; loaded asynchronously and bounded by the active chapter/region.
Prefetch only the minimum required destination subset before world commit; drop obsolete source-region handles after stable commit.
Never runtime resident; warehouse/source state only.

family_loading_policy.GLOBAL_SURFACE_LIBRARY: Load only the material/textures referenced by the active region package, not the entire global library.
family_loading_policy.FOREST_BIOME: Load only active biome species/materials/LODs and release route-incompatible biome assets.
family_loading_policy.WATER_RIVER_COAST: Load region-specific water/shore support only where the active kit requires it.
family_loading_policy.FORTIFICATION: Stream the active fortification kit and hero landmark dependencies; do not retain other fortress regions.
family_loading_policy.DARK_CAVE_RUIN: Stream the active cave/ruin subset; keep fog/VFX/audio bounded to the current chapter state.
family_loading_policy.PASTORAL_SETTLEMENT: Share technical support assets where safe, while keeping Shire/Bree hero silhouettes and identity separate.
family_loading_policy.VOLCANIC_DARKLAND: Keep high-cost VFX/material variants region-bound and profile before promotion.

transition_contract: Request destination soft assets before control handoff only when the chapter router has authorized the transition.
Do not publish destination world state until required streaming completes or fail-closed rollback runs.
Player movement hold/release remains owned by the existing world-transition transaction.
LivingWorldDirector activates destination population only after the committed world context is valid.
ShireNPCContextSubsystem must resolve context from the committed world state, not from prefetched-but-uncommitted destination data.
instrumentation: peak texture/VRAM observation on target device
evidence_boundary: Preparation only. No runtime streaming or memory acceptance claim.
